title: Letters from the Vatican and the Orthodox Church about his book

tellings.quote: I've sent my book and gotten letters back from the Vatican and also from from the Orthodox Orthodox Church hierarchy in uh in in Istanbul, Turkey

plain: A man named Ralph Larson says he sent his book to the Vatican, the headquarters of the Catholic Church, and to the leaders of the Orthodox Church in Istanbul, Turkey, and that both wrote back to him. He tells this himself on Michels's show in an episode with a former CIA officer, and he does not say what the letters said. If true, it would mean two of the oldest churches took notice of his book.
